Alif-Laam-Meem-Raa .   yeh ( Allah ki ) kitab ki aayaten hain , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kuch tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nazil kiya gaya hai , bar-haq hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi laarahey .

Allah woh hai jiss ney aesay sutonon kay baghair aasmano ko buland kiya jo tumhen nazar aa-saken ,   phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya .   her cheez aik moyyan miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . wohi tamam kamon ki tadbeer kerta hai . wohi inn nishaniyon ko khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay tum iss baat ka yaqeen kerlo kay ( aik din ) tumhen apney perwerdigar say jaa milna hai .

aur wohi zaat hai jiss ney yeh zameen phelai , uss mein pahar aur darya banaye , aur uss mein her qisam kay phalon kay do do jooray peda kiye .   woh din ko raat ki chadar urrha deta hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn sari baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker keren .

aur zameen mein mukhtalif qatey hain jo paas paas waqaey huye hain ,   aur angoor kay baagh aur khetiyan aur khujoor kay darkht hain , jinn mein say kuch dohray taney walay hain , aur kuch ikehray taney walay . sabb aik hi paani say sairaab hotay hain , aur hum unn mein say kissi ko zaeeqay mein doosray per foqiyat dey detay hain .   yaqeenan inn sabb baaton mein unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .

aur agar tumhen ( inn kafiron per ) taajjub hota hai to inn ka yeh kehna ( waqaee ) ajeeb hai kay : kiya jab hum mitti hojayen gay to kiya sach mooch hum naye siray say peda hon gay ?    yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apney rab ( ki qudrat ) ka inkar kiya hai , aur yehi woh log hain jinn kay galon mein toq parray huye hain ,   aur woh dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

aur yeh log khushhali ( ki miyaad khatam honey ) say pehlay tum say bad-haali ki jaldi machaye huye hain ,   halankay inn say pehlay aesay azab kay waqiyaat guzar chukay hain jiss ney logon  ko ruswa ker daala tha . aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay logon  kay liye unn ki ziyadti kay bawajood tumharay rab ki zaat aik moaaf kernay wali zaat hai , aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai kay uss ka azab bara sakht hai .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh kehtay hain kay :  bhala inn per ( yani aan-Hazrat SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay rab ki taraf say koi moajza kiyon nahi utaara gaya-?    ( aey payghumber ! ) baat yeh hai kay tum to sirf khatray say hoshiyar kernay walay ho , aur her qoam kay liye koi naa koi aisa shaks huwa hai jo hidayat ka raasta dikhaye .
jiss kissi mada ko jo hamal hota hai , Allah uss ko bhi janta hai , aur maon kay reham mein jo koi kami beshi hoti hai , uss ko bhi .   aur her cheez ka uss kay haan aik andaza muqarrar hai .
woh ghaeeb o hazir tamam baaton ka janney wala hai , uss ki zaat boht bari hai , uss ki shaan boht oonchi .
tum mein say koi chupkay say baat keray ya zor say , koi raat kay waqt chupa huwa ho , ya din kay waqt chal phir raha ho , woh sabb ( Allah kay ilm kay lehaz say ) barabar hain .

her shaks kay aagay aur peechay woh nigran ( farishtay ) muqarrar hain jo Allah kay hukum say baari baari uss ki hifazat kertay hain .   yaqeen jano kay Allah kissi qoam ki halat uss waqt tak nahi badlta jab tak woh khud apney halaat mein tabdeeli naa ley aaye .   aur jab Allah kissi qoam per koi aafat laney ka irada kerleta hai to uss ka taalna mumkin nahi , aur aesay logon  ka khud uss kay siwa koi rakhwala nahi hosakta .

wohi hai jo tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhlata hai jiss say tumhen ( uss kay girney ka ) darr bhi lagta hai , aur ( barish ki ) umeed bhi bandhti hai , aur wohi ( paani say ) laday huye badal uthata hai .

aur badalon ki garaj ussi ki tasbeeh aur hamd kerti hai ,   aur uss kay roab say farishtay bhi ( tasbeeh mein lagay huye hain ) aur wohi karrakti hoi bijliyan bhejta hai , phir jiss per chahta hai unhen museebat bana ker gira deta hai . aur inn ( kafiron ) ka haal yeh hai kay Allah hi kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , halankay uss ki taqat bari zabardast hai .

wohi hai jiss say dua kerna bar-haq hai . aur uss ko chorr ker yeh log jinn ( deotaon ) ko pukartay hain , woh unn ki duaon ka koi jawab nahi detay , albatta unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jo paani ki taraf apney dono haath phela ker yeh chahye kay paani khud uss kay mun tak phonch jaye , halankay woh kabhi khud mun tak nahi phonch sakta . aur ( button say ) kafiron kay dua kernay ka nateeja iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh bhatakti hi phirti rahey .
aur woh Allah hi hai jiss ko aasmano aur zameen ki sari makhlooqaat sajda kerti hain , kuch khushi say , kuch majboori say ,   aur unn kay saye bhi subha o shaam uss kay aagay sajda rez hotay hain .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  woh kon hai jo aasmano aur zameen ki perwerish kerta hai-?  kaho kay :  woh Allah hai !  kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum ney uss ko chorr ker aesay kaarsaz bana liye hain jinhen khud apney aap ko bhi naa koi faeeda phonchaney ki qudrat hasil hai naa nuqsan phonchaney ki ?  kaho kay :  kiya andha aur dekhney wala barabar hosakta hai-? ya kiya andheriyan aur roshni aik jaisi hosakti hain-?  ya inn logon  ney Allah kay aesay shareek maaney huye hain jinhon ney koi cheez ussi tarah peda ki ho jaisay Allah peda kerta hai ,   aur iss wajeh say inn ko dono ki takhleeq aik jaisi maloom horahi ho-? ( agar koi uss ghalat fehmi mein mubtala hai to iss say ) keh do kay :  sirf Allah her cheez ka khaliq hai , aur woh tanha hi aisa hai kay uss ka iqtidar sabb per hawi hai .

ussi ney aasman say paani barsaya jiss say nadi naalay apni apni bisaat kay mutabiq beh parray , phir paani kay relay ney phoolay huye jhaag ko oopper utha liya . aur issi qisam ka jhaag uss waqt bhi uthta hai jab log zewar ya bartan bananey kay liye dhaaton ko aag per tapatey hain . Allah haq aur batil ki misal issi tarah biyan ker raha hai kay ( dono qisam ka ) jo jhaag hota hai , woh to bahir gir ker zaya hojata hai , lekin woh cheez jo logon  kay liye faeeda mand hoti hai , woh zameen mein thehar jati hai .   issi qisam ki tamseelen hain jo Allah biyan kerta hai .

bhalai unhi logon  kay hissay mein hai jinhon ney apney rab ka kehna maana hai , aur jinhon ney uss ka kehna nahi maana , agar unn kay paas duniya bhar ki sari cheezen bhi hon gi , balkay itni hi aur bhi , to woh ( qayamat kay din ) apni jaan bachaney kay liye woh sabb kuch denay ko tayyar hojayen gay . inn logon  kay hissay mein buri tarah ka hisab hai , aur inn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

jo shaks yeh yaqeen rakhta ho kay tum per tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say jo kuch nazil huwa hai , bar-haq hai , bhala woh uss jaisa kaisay hosakta hai jo bilkul andha ho-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay naseehat to wohi log qubool kertay hain jo aqal o hosh rakhtay hon ,
. ( yani ) woh log jo Allah say kiye huye ehad ko poora kertay hain , aur moahiday ki khilaf warzi nahi kertay ,
aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jooray rakhney ka hukum diya hai , yeh log unhen jooray rakhtay hain ,   aur apney perwerdigar say dartay hain , aur hisab kay buray anjam say khof khatay hain .

aur yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apney rab ki khushnoodi ki khatir sabar say kaam liya hai ,   aur namaz qaeem ki hai , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq ata farmaya hai , uss mein say khufiya bhi aur aelania bhi kharch kiya hai , aur woh bad-sulooki ka difaa hussn-e-sulook say kertay hain .   watan-e-asli mein behtareen anjam inn ka hissa hai ,

yani hamesha rehney kay liye woh baaghaat jinn mein woh khud bhi dakhil hon gay , aur unn kay baap dadon , biwiyon aur aulad mein say jo naik hon gay , woh bhi . aur ( unn kay istaqbal kay liye ) farishtay unn kay paas her darwazay say ( yeh kehtay huye ) dakhil hon gay
kay  tum ney ( duniya mein ) jo sabar say kaam liya tha , uss ki badolat abb tum per salamti hi salamti nazil hogi , aur ( tumharay ) asli watan mein yeh tumhara behtareen anjam hai !

aur ( doosri taraf ) jo log Allah say kiye huye ehad ko mazbooti say baandhney kay baad torrtey hain , aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jooray rakhney ka hukum diya hai ,unhen kaat daaltay hain , aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain , to aesay logon  kay hissay mein lanat aati hai , aur asli watan mein bura anjam inhi ka hai .

Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai .   yeh ( kafir ) log dunyawi zindagi per magan hain , halankay aakhirat kay muqablay mein dunyawi zindagi ki haisiyat uss say ziyada nahi kay woh mamooli si poonji hai .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh kehtay hain kay inn per ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam per ) inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi utaari gaee-?   keh do kay :  Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur apney raastay per unhi ko lata hai jo uss ki taraf rujoo keren .
yeh woh log hain jo emaan laye hain , aur jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say itminan hasil kertay hain . yaad rakho kay sirf Allah ka ziker hi woh cheez hai jiss say dilon ko itminan naseeb hota hai .
. ( gharz ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay hissay mein khush haali bhi hai , aur behtareen anjam bhi .

. ( aey payghumber ! jiss tarah doosray Rasool bhejay gaye thay ) issi tarah hum ney tumhen aik aesi ummat mein Rasool bana ker bheja hai jiss say pehli boht si ummaten guzar chuki hain , takay tum inn kay samney woh kitab parh ker suna do jo hum ney wahi kay zariye tum per nazil ki hai , aur yeh log uss zaat ki nashukri ker rahey hain jo sabb per meharban hai . keh do kay :  woh mera paalney wala hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai , aur ussi ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .

aur agar koi Quran aisa bhi utarta jiss kay zariye pahar apni jagah say hata diye jatay , ya uss ki badolat zameen shaqq kerdi jati ( aur uss say darya nikal parrtay ) ya uss kay nateejay mein murdon say baat kerli jati , ( tab bhi yeh log emaan naa latay ) .   haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam tarr ikhtiyar Allah ka hai . kiya phir bhi emaan walon ney yeh soch ker apna zehan farigh nahi kiya kay agar Allah chahta to saray hi insanon ko ( zabardasti ) raah per ley aata?   aur jinhon ney kufr apnaya hai , unn per to unn kay kartoot ki wajeh say hamesha koi naa koi kharr-kharaney wali museebat parrti rehti hai , ya unn ki basti kay qareeb kahen nazil hoti rehti hai , yahan tak kay ( aik din ) Allah ney jo wada ker rakha hai , woh aa-ker poora hojaye ga .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum say pehlay payghumberon ka bhi mazaq uraya gaya tha , aur aesay kafiron ko bhi mein ney mohlat di thi , magar kuch waqt kay baad mein ney unn ko girift mein ley liya , abb dekh lo kay mera azab kaisa tha-?

bhala batao kay aik taraf woh zaat hai jo her her shaks kay her her kaam ki nigrani ker rahi hai , aur doosri taraf inn logon  ney Allah kay sath shareek maaney huye hain-?   kaho kay :  zara unn ( khuda  kay shareekon ) kay naam to batao ( agar koi naam lo gay ) to kiya Allah ko kissi aesay wajood ki khabar do gay jiss ka duniya bhar mein Allah ko bhi pata nahi hai ? ya khaali zaban say aesay naam ley lo gay jinn kay peechay koi haqeeqat nahi-?    haqeeqat to yeh hai kay inn kafiron ko apni makkaraana baaten bari khoobsurat lagti hain , aur ( iss tarah ) inn ki hidayat kay raastay mein rukawat peda hogaee hai . aur jissay Allah gumrahi mein parra rehney dey , ussay koi raah per laney wala moyassar nahi aa-sakta .
aesay logon  kay liye dunyawi zindagi mein bhi azab hai , aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka azab kahen ziyada bhari hoga , aur koi nahi hai jo enhen Allah ( kay azab ) say bacha sakay .

. ( doosri taraf ) woh jannat jiss ka muttaqi logon  say wada kiya gaya hai , uss ka haal yeh hai kay uss kay neechay nehren behti hain ,uss kay phal bhi sada bahar hain , aur uss ki chaon bhi ! yeh anjam hai unn logon  ka jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya , jabkay kafiron ka anjam dozakh ki aag hai .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss kalam say khush hotay hain jo tum per nazil kiya gaya hai . aur unhi girohon mein woh bhi hain jo iss ki baaz baaton ko manney say inkar kertay hain .   keh do kay :  mujhay to yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki ibadat kerun , aur uss kay sath kissi ko khudai mein shareek naa maanun , issi baat ki mein dawat deta hun , aur ussi ( Allah ) ki taraf mujhay loat ker jana hai .

aur issi tarah hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko arbi zaban mein aik hukum nama bana ker nazil kiya hai .   aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay paas jo ilm aa-chuka hai , agar uss kay baad bhi tum inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay chalay to Allah kay muqablay mein naa tumhara koi madadgaar hoga , naa koi bachaney wala .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say Rasool bhejay hain , aur unhen biwi bacchay bhi ata farmaye hain , aur kissi Rasool ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi tha kay woh koi aik aayat bhi Allah kay hukum kay baghair lasakay . her zamaney kay liye alag kitab di gaee hai .
Allah jiss ( hukum ) ko chahta hai , mansookh ker deta hai , aur ( jiss ko chahta hai ) baqi rakhta hai . aur tamam kitabon ki jo asal hai , woh ussi kay paas hai .

aur jiss baat ki dhamki hum inn ( kafiron ) ko detay hain , chahye uss ka koi hissa hum tumhen ( tumhari zindagi hi mein ) dikha den , ya ( uss say pehlay hi ) tumhen duniya say utha len , baharhal tumharay zimmay to sirf paygham phoncha dena hai , aur hisab lenay ki zimma daari humari hai .

kiya inn logon  ko yeh haqeeqat nazar nahi aai kay hum inn ki zameen ko chaaron taraf say ghatatay chalay aarahey hain-?   her hukum Allah deta hai . koi nahi hai jo uss kay hukum ko torr sakay , aur woh jald hisab lenay wala hai .

jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , chaalen unhon ney bhi chali then , lekin chaal to tamam tarr Allah hi ki chalti hai . koi bhi shaks jo kuch kerta hai , sabb ussay maloom hai , aur kafiron ko unqareeb pata lagg jaye ga kay asli watan ka naik anjam kiss kay hissay mein aata hai .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  tum payghumber nahi ho  keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi kay liye Allah kafi hai , neez her woh shaks jiss kay paas kitab ka ilm hai !
